responseText:
The mayor has set sights on a new expansion on one of the buildings. Yay or nay, what say you? 

Your opinions are requested as soon as possible. Cast your vote by speaking with the foreman at the construction site. And remember, every vote counts: votes FOR the construction speeds up the building time, while every vote AGAINST will slow down progress.
